name: io.github.linked-archi/linked-archi-mcp
title: Linked.Archi knowledge graph
description: Read-only analysis of ArchiMate, BPMN, C4, Backstage and LeanIX models converted to RDF graphs

packageArguments.name: --data
packageArguments.description: RDF file to query; .trig and .nq keep named graphs. Repeat to merge several files.

packageArguments.name: --endpoint
packageArguments.description: HTTPS SPARQL endpoint to query instead of local files.

packageArguments.name: --profile
packageArguments.description: Graph profile describing the dataset's vocabulary (default: linked-archi-default).
